assumptions: #1504: a rejected push is a race only when origin's latest differs from the lease read before the guard; an unchanged latest means the rejection had another cause (auth, network, ruleset), which a retry cannot clear, so the step stops after one attempt.
#1504: the issue's 'Awareness only' section (the guard ranks by tags on origin, not by releases that published) is out of scope and unchanged.

#1504: pinning `shell: bash` (bash -eo pipefail) came from the fleet's commit security review. The unset default is `bash -e`, so the old one-line `LEASE=$(git ls-remote | awk)` swallowed a failed ls-remote. The test now runs the step with the flags its `shell` implies.
#1568 item 3 also covers a `testFiles` entry without a `tests` list: the same mapping loop threw the same way (reproduced red), so it is the same bug, not new scope.

#1568 item 4: reachability was confirmed by reasoning, not by a live Stryker run (#486 still blocks the runner). Stryker's StringLiteral mutator replaces a template literal with an empty one, so a replacement of two backticks is an ordinary survivor.

#1568: the helpers live in a new ts/src/guardian/mutation-text.ts, declared in both entropy.entryPoints and performance.entryPoints, because mutation-report.ts was at 299/300 lines and the change took it to 317.

#1568 provenance nit: re-measured in a scratch worktree at 16a8ad2e with #1547's two test files. 4 of 7 fail; 'stops counting a survivor once the author suppressed it' passes at base. #1577 tracks the same correction, so it is referenced, not closed, here.
